description: This Java source file defines the FromJsonHelper class, which provides methods for parsing JSON data, extracting various data types, and validating JSON parameters within the Fineract project.

classes.name: FromJsonHelper
classes.description: A helper class for parsing JSON data, extracting various data types, and validating JSON parameters within the Fineract project.

methods.name: extractMap
methods.description: Extracts a Map<String, Boolean> from JSON string based on provided type.

methods.description: Validates nested JSON parameters with parent property name context.
